title: Maula mera vi ghar howe
body:
Maula mera vi ghar howe
Maula...
Rahe dil mein salamat ye ghum tera
Na ghum ho koi is ghum ke siwa
manzoor karo shahe karbobala
har momin ke ye dil ki dua
ye dil ki dua, ye dil ki dua
<<MINI>>
maula mera vi ghar howe, uthe alma di chaa howe..(2)
maula mera vi ghar howe, uthe alma di chaa howe
<<DIVIDER>>
zikr zehra de laa laa'nda, mere ghar vi bayaa'n howe
<<MINI>>
maula mera vi ghar howe, uthe alma di chaa howe..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Chade jad chand moharram da
safe matam bichawa'n mai
gharche zakir bulawaa'n mai
teri majlis karawaa'n mai
zuljanah garcho'n jad nikle
jag girya kuna howe
<<MINI>>
maula mera vi ghar howe, uthe alma di chaa howe..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Dukhi zainab jo na kita
tera matam karawaa'n mai
teri phoodi bichawaa'n mai
othe langar pakawaa'n mai
azadari le ee maula
koi aisi witha howe
<<MINI>>
maula mera vi ghar howe, uthe alma di chaa howe..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Azakhana mere ghar bane
jithe masoom awandge
payr pawandge jadd wede
paag mere jagawandge
panja baara te chauda di
uthe sibto sanaa howe
<<MINI>>
maula mera vi ghar howe, uthe alma di chaa howe..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Maula menu mile je ghar
jhula asghar sajawaa'n mai
aap laawa'n sabeela mai
sabnu pani piyawaa'n mai
jithe mashke sakina howe
ghazi da nishaa'n howe
<<MINI>>
maula mera vi ghar howe, uthe alma di chaa howe..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Mere ghar jo baramad howe
jaddo taboot beemar daa
yaad kar maula sajjad nu
rowe dil har azaadar daa
sadqa beemar sajjad daa
maaf har ek gunaah howe
<<MINI>>
maula mera vi ghar howe, uthe alma di chaa howe..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Menu milya jo hai ghum tera
nasl dar nasl milda rawe
panjetan di mohabbat daa
phool khurshid ae khilda rawe
raazi sarwar te mehshar de din
dukhi zainab di maa howe
<<MINI>>
maula mera vi ghar howe, uthe alma di chaa howe..(2)
